method.space: linear sRGB, constant CIE Y, anchor 0.22
method.procedure: All three pathways are measured, interleaved, and shuffled. Each pair is the same step on both sides of gray. Some pairs are the same color on both cards. A pathway that stays visible at the small step is confirmed once later and then sampled less — it is not dropped. One, two, three, or none may come back high. Pure red and pure blue are references and do not change that reading.
method.priorsRole: Cone-isolation directions only choose where to look first. They are not the output.

summary: Las tres vías quedan medidas. violáceo 0.019 o menos. rojizo 0.061. verdoso 0.032. Control 0.024 o menos. Solo «rojizo» queda por encima del control. También mido «rojo extremo» 0.080; «magenta · al lado 20.6°» 0.048; «cian · al lado» 0.091.

fit.method: Peak absolute distance in linear sRGB (unit direction × scale), compared with the control. Gamut fraction is not the rank: a short-gamut axis must not look worse just because it clips sooner.

luminance.method: Minimum motion at 1 Hz, eight thin stripes. Every trial asks which way the darker stripes drift. Coarse steps until the first still, then fine steps to the last still on the dim side and the last still on the bright side. The result is those two edges. Partners are only axes the first test left open. A closed neighbor is never the reference. A healthy color is only the ruler against gray.
luminance.reading: 4 franjas. «rojizo» frente a «magenta» se queda quieta de 0.94× a 1.00×. El abanico mide 0.06. 11 muestras. «cian» frente a «rojo extremo» se queda quieta de 0.84× a 0.90×. El abanico mide 0.06. 9 muestras. «rojo extremo» frente a «rojizo» se queda quieta de 0.98× a 1.10×. El abanico mide 0.12. 11 muestras. La regla: quieto en 1.06×. Se mueve en 1.00× y en 1.12×. 7 muestras.
